open_questions: Shell Risella X 430 is described as a GTL-derived process oil. API lubricant base-oil Group classification is treated as Not Required under the proposed project applicability rule; confirm acceptance of this interpretation with the professor.
Chemistry is recorded from TDS DL2-13727.pdf, page 1, dated 2014-06-02: GTL-derived hydrocarbon fluid, highly saturated with a high degree of iso-paraffinic structures.

MRV low-temperature pumpability testing is treated as Not Required for the documented process-oil application. No grade-specific MRV apparent viscosity, yield stress, or test temperature is reported in the supplied TDS.
Noack volatility is reported as 2.0 mass% at 250°C for 1 hour, ASTM D5800, in TDS DL2-13727.pdf.
TDS DL2-13727.pdf reports density of 828 kg/m3 at 15°C, whereas SDS DL2-13731.pdf reports 824.8 kg/m3 at 15°C. The discrepancy requires reconciliation.
The historical TDS is dated 2014-06-02 and the cited SDS was revised 2020-01-13. Confirm applicable document revisions before final approval.
